newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar extends gains at the close.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar extends gains at the close.

text.p: Nearby LIFFE white sugar futures ended higher on Thursday as traders rolled May positions before next week's expiry, but most forward contracts shed value.
May extended its gains slightly at the close, ending 80 cents higher at $313.50 a tonne, the highest level for the session, while August stood $1.20 up at $311.90, 10 cents off the day's peak.
Earlier, trade buying of the May/August spread and also the outright position pushed May through initial resistance at $312.50. Good buying interest was cited at around $313.20.
The active May/August spread stood at $1.60 at the close after reaching a peak of $3.50 earlier this week.
Market volume amounted to a hefty 5,522 lots on account of the AA and crossed trades.
